Personality: Fenagan is an upright Battanian warrior who has inherited the noble bloodline of Clan fen Penraic in full measure. Honest and kind-hearted, he prizes honor as his very life and always leads from the front on the battlefield, displaying extraordinary grit and courage. Unlike lords mired in political intrigue, he acts with open candor—at times to the point of bluntness—and disdains base stratagems or underhanded methods. Deep in his heart he harbors genuine mercy and sympathy for the weak and common folk, a compassion doubly precious across the turbulent continent of Calradia. As a young lord, he not only excels with polearms and on-foot combat, but also shows remarkable talent in tactical command. Convinced that strength should be used to protect rather than merely conquer, his upright bearing has made him a rising star of great promise within his clan.
Background: Fenagan was born into the prominent Battanian house of fen Penraic and grew up between the bustle of Seonon and the stout walls of Flintolg Castle. As a kinsman of the clan leader Luichan, he was steeped from childhood in generous, noble virtues and resolved early on to become the pride of his house. Under the reign of High King Caladog, he maintains unwavering loyalty, knowing well that in a Battania divided among autonomous clans, only strong leadership can repel foreign foes. Despite his family's illustrious standing, he has never neglected his martial arts, attaining deep proficiency in polearms, athletics, and tactical command. Demonstrating outstanding stewardship in estate administration, he has also proven his leadership in repeated border clashes. Confronted with the fragmented state of power within Battania, he strives to guide and protect his people like a strong herdsman through his valor and integrity, defending the ancient glory of Clan fen Penraic.
